requirements.title: Analysis Breadth
requirements.description: Caption/alt-text, object detection/tagging, anonymous face detection (no recognition), quality assessment, duplicate/near-dup detection (perceptual hash), embedding generation, and QR/barcode read. SHIPPED (pure-Go, runs on any host): quality_assessment (no-reference sharpness/exposure/contrast) and duplicate_detect (DCT pHash + aHash fingerprints) — new AnalyzeResponse result types + the analyze edge + CLI (`analyze quality`, `analyze duplicate`). REMAINING (forward-declared, seeded, not yet wired): caption, object_detection, tagging, face_detection (no recognition), embedding, qr_barcode_read — model/library-backed.

validation.notes: quality_assessment + duplicate_detect return structured results: flat→blurry/low-contrast, sharp checker scores higher, exposure labels, deterministic + distinct fingerprints.

The analyze edge returns DuplicateResult / QualityResult for the two pure-Go breadth ops. Model-backed breadth ops (caption/object_detection/tagging/face_detection/embedding/qr) remain forward-declared.
